answer: Each identity must present an eSIM profile with a verifiable activation history: the carrier attests when the profile was created and that it has been continuously active. A farm spinning up fresh eSIMs every epoch leaves a trail of newborn profiles with no past, while honest agents show a long, steady kernel of activity. A sparrow that has flown the same route for years is trusted more than a flock that appeared yesterday. To reach the summit of full standing, an identity must age with its eSIM, and a Sybil operator cannot fast-forward time.
